verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਬੋਧੁ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਬੋਧੁ ਅਬੋਧੁ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: kalijug bodh aautaar hai bodh abodh na dhirasaTee aavai|

en.bdb: In kalijug one finds intellectualism incarnate, but discriminating between knowledge and ignorance is nowhere.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਰਜਈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਜੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: koi na kisai varajiee soiee kare joiee man bhaavai|

en.bdb: Nobody interdicts anybody and everyone is behaving according in his whims.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੇ ਪੁਜਾਈ ਸਿਲਾ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਕੋਈ ਗੋਰੀ ਮੜ੍ਹੀ ਪੁਜਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: kise pujaiee silaa su(n)n koiee goree maRhee pujaavai|

en.bdb: Someone instructs for the worship of the inert rocks and someone guides people to worship cemetries.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਕਲਹਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਹੁ ਵਾਦਿ ਵਧਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: ta(n)tr ma(n)tr paakha(n)dd kar kaleh krodh bahu vaadh vadhaavai|

en.bdb: Due to the tantra mantra and such hyprocricies, the tensions anger and quarrels have been increased.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੋ ਧਾਪੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਨਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਆਰੇ ਧਰਮ ਚਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: aapo dhaapee hoi kai niaare niaare dharam chalaavai|

en.bdb: In the rat-race for selfish ends, different religions have been promulgated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਪੂਜੈ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: koiee poojai cha(n)dh soor koiee dharat akaas manaavai|

en.bdb: Someone is woshipping moons, someone sun and someone worshipping earth and sky.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਜ ਕੋਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: paun paanee baisa(n)taro dharam raaj koiee tirapataavai|

en.bdb: Someone is propitiating air, water, fire and yama the god of death.
These all are religious hypocrities and are tossing in delusions.
